title: Codex ChatGPT auth rejects gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6.1-luna defaults
description: Live smoke on 2026-10-09 showed both new OpenAI defaults rejected with 400 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account'. Re-verify availability before merging eshyra-i9sb; defaults currently unusable on this account unless ESHYRA_MODEL/ESHYRA_AUDIT_MODEL overridden.
notes:
Supervisor check 2026-10-09 (~/.codex/logs_2.sqlite, read-only): gpt-6.1-sol completed turns with token usage on this account through 2026-10-04 00:30 CDT, matching when Sol capacity became unavailable; rejections are recent. gpt-6.1-luna has no successful request here and is absent from models_cache.json. Likely availability (sol) / not-yet-rolled-out (luna), not a wrong id.
ROOT CAUSE (supervisor, 2026-10-09): not account availability. @openai/codex-sdk 0.157.0 bundles codex 0.157 which gets the 400 for gpt-6.1-sol; codex-cli 0.162.0 on the same account returns ok. gpt-6.1-luna was a mistaken id (user: audit is gpt-6-luna). Fix = bump @openai/codex-sdk to 0.162.0 (separate dependency PR).
close_reason: Root cause was the pinned codex-sdk 0.157 bundled binary; fixed by PR #620 (0.162.0). gpt-6.1-luna was a mistaken id; audit default is gpt-6-luna (PR #619).
